stops.name: Pyrénées National Park
stops.detail: Pyrénées National Park (French: Parc national des Pyrénées; Occitan: Parc Nacional dels Pireneus) is a French national park located within the departments of Hautes-Pyrénées and Pyrénées-Atlantiques. The park is located along the border of France and Spain along the Pyrenees Mountains, with a scenic landscape offering a variety of outdoor activities including hiking, skiing, mountain climbing and observing wildlife.
